declarations.state_ownership: Owns video_jobs (migration 0047, organization_id by 0060; short-lived progress, lib/content/video/job-store.ts header), the Media LEGO tables media_qa_reports, media_releases, media_delivery_attempts, media_outcome_snapshots (0065, 0068), media_billing_accounts, media_credit_ledger, media_provider_profiles (0066), media_transcription_jobs (0069), media_story_bible_revisions (0070, 0071), media_production_projects (0071), and the video rows of media_assets (0038, 0067), all in lobster-factory/packages/db/migrations. The video files themselves live in the customer's R2 video bucket (lib/content/video/reconcile.ts:16-19). The code lives in lib/content/video and app/api/video; lib/video holds only this manifest.
declarations.behavior_ownership: Script -> scenes -> render -> QA -> release -> delivery for short videos: lib/content/video/video-script-core.ts (script, video.script grant :202), lib/content/blocks/video-pipeline.ts (scene images through lib/tarot/image-gen.ts, motion through lib/tarot/video-motion-gen.ts, B-roll through pexels.ts), render-client.ts and remotion-client.ts (HTTP to the two render services), release-gate.ts and release-evidence.ts (release approval), delivery-receipts.ts (idempotent delivery), reconcile.ts (orphan repair), payment-provider.ts (Stripe checkout for media credits). HTTP shells: app/api/video/* (28 entries).
declarations.public_api_event_contract: HTTP: /api/video/* (generate, status, regenerate-image, render-draft, remotion-render, remotion-job-status, timeline, story-bibles, qa, release, outcomes, credits, billing, transcription, and more); host cron POST /api/internal/video/reconcile (x-ops-sync-key). Outbound: video-service POST /render at VIDEO_SERVICE_URL (lib/content/video/render-client.ts:55), remotion-service POST /render at REMOTION_SERVICE_URL (remotion-client.ts:7), the transcription worker at MEDIA_TRANSCRIBE_WORKER_URL (app/api/video/transcription/dispatch/route.ts:22-24), Pexels (pexels.ts:45), Stripe checkout (payment-provider.ts:24-31). Host cron: scripts/reconcile-videos.sh twice a day (scripts/cron.d/awarewave-schedules, 06:00/18:00 Taipei, 3 tries per run) calls /api/internal/video/reconcile (reconcile-videos.sh:2); /api/internal/video/cleanup is for a weekly cron behind x-ops-sync-key (internal/video/cleanup/route.ts:2-6; no door serves it). No Trigger task.
declarations.invariants: A release needs one current QA report per required kind whose checksum matches the candidate asset; a duplicate, missing, failed or stale report refuses the release (lib/content/video/release-gate.ts), evaluated from authoritative records (release-evidence.ts:94) by a role allowed to approve (app/api/video/release/route.ts:3-5). Media providers are fail-closed: an empty MEDIA_PROVIDER_ALLOWLIST allows none and browsers cannot supply base URLs (lib/content/video/provider-policy.ts:5-14). Credit reservation is idempotent per key (app/api/video/credits/reserve/route.ts:20, rpc media_credit_reserve). Card data never enters this app (payment-provider.ts:3). Reconciliation is idempotent by object_key (reconcile.ts header).
declarations.dependencies: supabase (tables above), video-service (TTS + ffmpeg composition, render-client.ts header) and remotion-service (timeline renders, remotion-client.ts header), R2 video bucket (reconcile.ts:16-19, lib/storage/r2.ts:290), Anthropic for scripts (video-pipeline.ts:604), Replicate / OpenAI image and motion models through the shared tarot toolkit with video's own grants (video.image video-pipeline.ts:362, video.motion :412; OpenAI narration asks video.tts, render-client.ts:141), Pexels B-roll (pexels.ts:45), optional Stripe (payment-provider.ts:25), optional transcription worker apps/video-whisper-worker (a separate RTX machine process, not a compose service; its README). products.ts dependsOn is content (release delivery /api/content/social-publish, the ScriptForge site list /api/content/sites; its code lives in lib/content/video). Inventory: ADR 017 section 5 row content (video).
declarations.failure_isolation_boundary: Long renders run asynchronously: /generate returns a job id and /status polls, so a render outlives the 100 s edge timeout, and job progress survives container restarts in video_jobs (lib/content/video/job-store.ts header). A finished video that was never recorded (closed tab, restart) is repaired by the 15-minute reconcile from R2 (reconcile.ts header). A missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY returns 503 for that request only (video-pipeline.ts:604-605). The render services run in their own compose files and networks (docker-compose.video.yml, docker-compose.remotion.yml).
declarations.data_lifecycle: video_jobs rows expire after 1 hour and are cleaned when a job is created (lib/content/video/job-store.ts:61, :115); videos older than N days (default 30) are deleted by POST /api/internal/video/cleanup (internal/video/cleanup/route.ts:3, :26-27); story bible revisions are versioned and approved through rpc approve_media_story_bible_revision (0070, 0071); the media credit ledger keeps every reservation (0066).
declarations.observability_contract: Image and motion costs are logged per call (lib/content/blocks/video-pipeline.ts:26 logImageCost); QA reports, releases and delivery attempts are stored rows (0065), outcome snapshots record post-release results (0065); the reconcile cron alerts instead of only writing /var/log/reconcile-videos.log (scripts/reconcile-videos.sh:7, :24-25).
declarations.migration_rollback_contract: Migration 0069 ships 0069_media_transcription_jobs.down.sql beside the forward file; 0038, 0047, 0060, 0065, 0066, 0067 and 0068 have a down script in lobster-factory/packages/db/scripts (<n>_down.sql, run by hand); 0070 and 0071 have no down file in either place and roll forward only.
declarations.replacement_strategy: Each render backend is one HTTP client with its own URL (render-client.ts, remotion-client.ts) behind the shared renderer auth (renderer-auth.ts); image and motion models sit behind lib/tarot/image-gen.ts and video-motion-gen.ts; payments sit behind the PaymentProvider interface (payment-provider.ts:12, MEDIA_PAYMENT_PROVIDER :24); the pipeline steps are content blocks registered in lib/content/blocks/registry.ts.

acceptance.test: blocks stale, failed, and duplicate evidence (lib/content/video/__tests__)
acceptance.expect: QA 報告與候選影片不符、失敗或重複時，發佈被拒絕並說明是哪一項

acceptance.test: generate a short video and close the page before it finishes
acceptance.expect: 影片完成後仍出現在媒體庫（定期對帳補記），不會成為孤兒檔案

configuration.apiKeys: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, REPLICATE_API_TOKEN / OPENAI_API_KEY for images and motion, PEXELS_API_KEY, R2_* video bucket (reconcile.ts:16-19); STRIPE_SECRET_KEY with MEDIA_PAYMENT_PROVIDER and MEDIA_CHECKOUT_ALLOWED_ORIGIN only if the customer sells media credits (payment-provider.ts:24-31); MEDIA_PROVIDER_ALLOWLIST lists the providers the customer allows (provider-policy.ts:7).
configuration.generatedByInstall: VIDEO_SERVICE_URL, REMOTION_SERVICE_URL, MEDIA_RENDER_AUTH_TOKEN / VIDEO_SERVICE_SECRET / REMOTION_AUTH_TOKEN (lib/content/video/renderer-auth.ts:28-34), OPS_PROXY_SHARED_SECRET (video/cleanup/route.ts:20); MEDIA_TRANSCRIBE_WORKER_URL / _TOKEN / MEDIA_TRANSCRIBE_CALLBACK_BASE_URL only with a transcription worker.
configuration.installUnit: Each services entry names the service this product calls; the installer installs that entry's whole compose file (ADR 017 section 5 inventory).
